releaseNotes: Opened every session with three moves the entrypoint named nowhere before: prove the runtime is current, establish autonomy and spend authority, and compute the ready frontier. All three capabilities already shipped; no interactive run could reach any of them, so launches improvised past the runtime they were meant to use.

Made the freshness check refuse to report a pass it did not earn — an installed runtime compared against itself is now an error naming `npm run sync:runtime`, while a source checkout comparing to itself stays silent, so the gate has teeth without nagging maintainers.

Added core/session/plan.ts, the frontier for a session that is a conversation: it evaluates the founder's real grants, waivers, and budget, reports ready work already grouped into parallel-safe batches alongside what is parked and why, and writes nothing.

Asked the founder how much the business may spend and over what period, recorded through the reducer as a budget-ledger allocation — BudgetBalance.allocated was a modelled field that no conversation ever filled.
Re-scoped autonomy onboarding off 'scheduled, unattended work' so it fires on a business's first session, interactive included, because an interactive launch acts too.

Pinned the session-bootstrap contract into the autopilot required terms, the same guard runtime routing already carries, so a later compaction cannot quietly drop it while every other check stays green.
